Name: Zebul
Summary: Zebul, ruler of Shechem under Abimelech, warned Abimelech of Gaal's revolt and drove Gaal from the city.
KeyStory: When Gaal boasted in Shechem, Zebul sent word to Abimelech, counselled him to lie in wait, and thrust Gaal out through the gate.
RelatedPeople: Abimelech, Son of Gideon; Gaal, Son of Ebed
LifeLesson: Loyalty to a bad king still served the city's order — for a time.
